note: index = the clip number in the GLB (Crucible). Unity finds clips by name.

clips.name: Blaster_Fire
clips.notes: One shot per cycle; loop it while the trigger is held. Kick back 0.12 m and up 3 degrees, recovered by the next shot. Faster or slower fire = play it faster or slower (rate = shots per second / 6).

props.notes: One shot per cycle; loop it while the trigger is held. Kick back 0.12 m and up 3 degrees, recovered by the next shot. Faster or slower fire = play it faster or slower (rate = shots per second / 6).

PowerUp.notes: Start all three on the same frame. While moving, play only the torso and head clips; the legs keep their locomotion.

CannonShot_L.notes: Play after Cannon_ChargeStart (0.8 s) and Cannon_ChargeLoop (looped while held). Start both clips on the same frame.

CannonShot_R.notes: Play after Cannon_ChargeStart (0.8 s) and Cannon_ChargeLoop (looped while held). Start both clips on the same frame.
